Built-in policies handle media music, Siri responses and navigation prompts separately. Change, preview or restore the recommended policy for each. Calls retain separate handling. Changes apply on the next connection.

The recommended policy uses a separate system policy for media music, Siri or navigation. You can choose another usage policy below. Legacy audio streams 1–10 are for advanced troubleshooting; the numbers do not identify speaker positions. Selecting or previewing does not save changes. Saved changes apply on the next connection.
Previewing does not save settings. Make sure vehicle audio is audible and operate only while parked.

Decoder initialization failed, or no video output was confirmed after receiving data. Diagnostic logs include configuration, decoding and rendering details. Turn off HEVC, switch to H.264 and reconnect. Hotspot settings will remain unchanged.
